[[Nihanu]] is a [[collector]], a type of [[NPC]] that exchanges [[Trophy|trophies]] for weapons.

==Locations==
*[[Kourna]]
**{{NPC location|Barbarous Shore}}

==Dialogue==
:''"[[Corsair]] treasure, that's what I'm after! Those...uh...terrible, awful corsairs have more than their share, don't you think? Ha! I know about a group of low-lifes who answer to no captain and have come into a great deal of booty. I'm only interested in a little of their gold, you know, to prove those ruffians have been brought to justice. Once you get a few coins for me, you can keep the rest! Promise! Bring me 5 Gold Doubloons to prove you fought the corsairs, and I'll give you something for your trouble:''"
